cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make the Second Step First
cards.instruction: Get them to accept a small consequence that makes the larger risky action feel already underway.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Pay the climbing-course deposit first. Use the booking reference, please; we can discuss the cliff afterward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's a course reservation, not a climb. The deposit comes back if we attend the first lesson; read that condition before you pay.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So I'd have to turn up just to get my own money back.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Attend and claim it, yes. Put the lesson in your calendar beside the payment. Once both entries match, we can talk about whether you want to climb.

reason: A corrects booking/attendance terms to make B accept a small payment consequence before the larger risky decision.
